title: ficus deltoidea var. kunstleri
intro: Ficus deltoidea var. kunstleri, commonly known as the Borneo banyan or Kulai tree, is a variety of the Ficus deltoidea species, a type of fig tree native to Southeast Asia. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, which include treating fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, as well as acting as a diuretic. The therapeutic actions of Ficus deltoidea var. kunstleri include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
